description_en: Creates a notification configuration for Auto Scaling events and resource changes to help you track scaling group dynamics and automate the management of Auto Scaling events
description_zh: 调用API CreateNotificationConfiguration创建弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知，帮助您及时掌握伸缩组的动态，进一步实现弹性伸缩事件的自动化管理
kebab_example: aliyun ess create-notification-configuration --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --notification-arn acs:mns:cn-beijing:1614568843400000:queue/modifyLifecycleHo0000 --notification-types AUTOSCALING:SCALE_OUT_SUCCESS --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNotificationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the notification recipient. The following notification methods are supported when you configure the Settings for this parameter:

Cloud monitoring. Format: `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`.
MNS queue. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.

Variables in the formats:
`region-id`: the ID of the region where the scaling group resides.
`account-id`: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can invoke the STS GetCallerIdentity operation to obtain the AccountId response parameter, or view it by clicking your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Alibaba Cloud Management Console.
`queuename`: the name of the MNS queue.
`topicname`: the name of the MNS topic
parameters.help_zh:
通知对象标识符，设置本参数时支持以下通知方式：

云监控，参数取值格式：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`。
MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
`region-id`：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
`account-id`：阿里云账号ID，可调用STS GetCallerIdentity接口获取返回参数AccountId，或在阿里云控制台右上角头像处查看。
``queuename``：MNS队列的名称。
`topicname`：MNS主题的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

parameters.help_en:
The types of Auto Scaling events and resource changes for which you want to receive notifications. You can specify multiple values by using a repeated list.

You can invoke the DescribeNotificationTypes operation to query parameter values
parameters.help_zh:
一类或者多类弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知。多个取值使用重复列表的形式。

您可以调用API DescribeNotificationTypes接口查询参数取值
parameters.name: notification_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the scaling group belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The time zone for notifications.
Specify the time zone offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), such as UTC+8 or UTC-7
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知的时区。
时区相对于协调世界时的偏移量： 如 UTC+8（东八区）、UTC-7（西七区）等
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en:
The encoding method for the notification content. Valid values:

PlainText: no encoding. The content is transmitted in plaintext.
Base64: Base64 encoding.

Default value: Base64.
The Settings for this parameter are supported only for MNS notification recipients
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知内容的编码方式。取值范围：

PlainText：不编码，采用明文传输。
Base64：Base64 编码。

默认值：Base64。
仅支持MNS通知对象设置该参数
parameters.name: message_encoding
